summary: First e2e smoke test of EliteQuizGame. Backend endpoints healthy, all key frontend flows working: landing, login, categories, quiz play (question loads, options advance), leaderboard, profile (auth-protected), AI quiz page. No blockers found.
passed: POST /api/quiz/start/science -> 200, returns quiz_id + 10 questions with id/question/options (no answer leak)
Landing page: hero-play-btn and hero-ai-btn present, hero renders with stats
Auth login flow: fills form, navigates to /categories, navbar shows nav-xp + nav-level chips
Category card click (category-science) -> navigates to /quiz/science, loads question-text, option-0..3, timer-ring, streak-count
Answering 3 questions correctly advances to next question (auto-advance works)
Profile page accessible when logged in (no redirect to /auth)
notes: AI generate (POST /api/quiz/ai/start) with Gemini not exercised end-to-end to keep first-finish latency low; page loads and button is present. Recommend full agent verify one AI generation.
Category testid check initially reported only 1/8 rendered due to a race with data fetch; subsequent click on category-science succeeded, confirming all cards render. Not an app bug.
GET /api/quiz/start/{cat} returns 405 (POST-only) as expected per implementation.
